parameters.prompt: The exact snake-tailed demon lady in the reference performs ONE quick close-range snap in place. She leans the upper body back slightly, then darts the upper body and head forward toward screen left with both clawed hands reaching forward, snaps the mouth shut once, then pulls back and calmly returns to the exact original pose and holds it. Her face stays the same human face the whole time: the mouth opens only a little, no fangs grow, the jaw never stretches or transforms. The coiled tail stays in place on the ground and does not slither, lift or whip. Exactly two arms and one snake tail. Keep the same three-quarter left view, face, hair, headdress, clothing and scaled tail. No slithering, turning around, jumping, tail strike, second attack, extra limbs, extra tails, weapon, spitting, blood, red mist, petals. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, smears, glow, energy, coloured light, liquid, spray, projectile, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shockwave, rings, shadow or text.
